_note: Shipped default is deliberately NON-QUALIFYING and cannot be made permissive from here. Every floor below is the code-defined floor and every cap is the code-defined ceiling: policy may only RAISE a floor and only NARROW a cap (see ConvertTo-ReviewerEvalEffectivePolicy). This file is read only by tools/, never by the reviewer agent, and it can neither enable a delivery gate nor sign anything. partitionSalt, adjudicationSalt and holdoutPercent are deliberately absent: they are frozen inside the signed corpus so no policy edit can reshuffle the holdout partition. See docs/evaluation-harness.md.
